name: Sons of Cerberus
source:
You regain consciousness, confusion clouding your mind, memories mixed and hazy... Who are the four strangers you hear arguing?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你恢复了意识，却满脑子混乱，记忆模糊，搅成一团…你听见四个陌生人在争吵，他们是谁？
